Class ControllerAddExperienceInformation

java.lang.Object
guiAddExperienceInformation.ControllerAddExperienceInformation
public class ControllerAddExperienceInformation extends Object

Title: ControllerAddExperienceInformation Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Add Experience Information Page. This class provides the controller actions basic on the user's use of the JavaFX GUI widgets defined by the View class. After validating the user input, this class will use the experience information to create a new Lesson Learned object and insert it into the database. The class has been written assuming that the View or the Model are the only class methods that can invoke these methods. This is why each has been declared at "protected". Do not change any of these methods to public.

  • Method Details

    • addExperienceInformation

      protected static void addExperienceInformation()

      Method: addExperienceInformation()

      Description: This method is called when the user presses the add button in the View class. It registers the experience information of what was done, how it was done, how long it took, and the effort used by the various team members to the lesson database. It uses the information of an existing lesson. The addExperienceInformation method in the LessonsLearned entity class uses the current lesson's details, which were set by examining the lesson being added on to by this method.

    • evaluateExpInfoValidity

      protected static boolean evaluateExpInfoValidity()

      Method: evaluateLessonValidity()

      Description: This method is called when the contributor presses the add button. It checks to ensure the text fields contain valid inputs before allowing the lesson to be added to the database. Text fields are invalid if they are empty or greater than 255 characters.

    • performReturn

      protected static void performReturn()

      Method: performReturn()

      Description: This method returns the user to the List Lessons page.

    • performLogout

      protected static void performLogout()

      Method: performLogout()

      Description: This method logs out the current user and proceeds to the normal login page where existing users can log in or potential new users with a invitation code can start the process of setting up an account.

    • performQuit

      protected static void performQuit()

      Method: performQuit()

      Description: This method terminates the execution of the program. It leaves the database in a state where the normal login page will be displayed when the application is restarted.
